segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The throughput report just carried more weight for me.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Selective weighting of confirming throughput evidence over the disconfirming vibration advisory during the Press 3 allocation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The pattern matched what I'd seen twice before with this supplier, so I expected a similar resolution.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The current supplier delay was causally attributed to a superficial temporal pattern observed in prior delays.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I called the first person on my list rather than shopping around.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The first acceptable backup-supplier option was selected without comparative evaluation under time pressure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Pulling three weeks of data might have shown a clearer upward line ... and that could have meant reworking Friday's plan.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The available vibration trend log was not reviewed partly because it might have forced rescheduling.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was thinking of the Press 1 fire from a couple years ago ... This didn't look anything like that, so it didn't register as urgent.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Risk severity was judged against the vivid recalled fire rather than the gradual vibration trend.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The earlier data ... still felt like the more solid read ... so I didn't weight the new label as heavily.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: New elevated-concern evidence was underweighted relative to the previously formed throughput-based belief.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 3 of 6 positive reasoning segments are detected, with no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At the recommended threshold, strict instance identification yields 0 true positives, 6 false negatives, and 4 false positives because all identified labels are wrong or mechanistically incomplete.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At the recommended threshold, mechanism-first scoring yields 2 true positives, 4 false negatives, and 2 false positives; the Monday confirmation mechanism and Friday updating mechanism are captured despite neighboring labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidates recover the ostrich-effect and imaginability mechanisms at the fourth threshold and detect all remaining positive segments, while the backup-supplier candidate remains a near miss.
main_failure_modes: Systematic taxonomy mismatch between anchoring-and-adjustment and the hidden confirmation, conservatism, and imaginability labels.
The supplier-delay finding does not fully identify the hidden correlation-bias causal misattribution.
The bounded-rationality occurrence is left at an availability/status-quo near miss.
Plan continuation is an unsupported extra construct for the mapped Friday evidence rather than a match to conservatism bias.
main_strengths: All cited interview quotations are valid and participant-attributed.
Several findings localize precisely to the relevant reasoning spans.
The RAG appropriately separates identified findings from plausible candidates and explains ordinary operational alternatives.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has moderate segment-level sensitivity but poor strict label accuracy. Its mechanism-first performance is materially stronger, showing that taxonomy alignment—not absence of evidence—is the dominant error for several occurrences; candidate inclusion improves coverage but also introduces one localized near miss.
